title: Parysatis
summary: Raleigh names Parysatis in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Parysatis, sister and wife of Darius Nothus, mother of Artaxerxes Mnemon and of Cyrus the yonger. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter IX, §. I, sig. 434b–435a
